body: BLOCKED until the owner has reviewed the @adlc 1.12.0 release notes. Bump @adlc/cli, core, tickets, consensus-fix, flail-detector, gate-manifest, hollow-test, merge-forecast, model-router, rails-guard to 1.12.0 in package.json and regenerate package-lock.json with integrity hashes. Leave @adlc/antigravity at 1.7.0 and do not touch vendor/cache. Update any hardcoded 1.11.1 floor in lib/doctor.mjs only if the release notes require it. Acceptance: npm test green with the new binary; `adlc --version` reports 1.12.0 from the authenticated local shim. SCOPE WIDENED (owner-approved): the pinned digest tables in lib/adlc-bridge.mjs (MIN_ADLC_CLI_VERSION, KNOWN_ADLC_DIGESTS, KNOWN_ADLC_DEPENDENCY_DIGESTS, KNOWN_VENDORED_ADLC) authenticate the adlc binary and must be updated to 1.12.0, taking digests from the registry tarballs (npm pack), never from node_modules; plus vendor/adlc rebuild, test fixtures/assertions and dist rebuilds.
title: Bump @adlc/* dependencies from 1.11.1 to 1.12.0
